---
title: "Home Alignment Index"
---

**This is a dummy site for practice.** The Home Alignment Index (HAI) is invented. It scores how strongly one of four places in my life (India, France, Italy, Germany) "points towards" another in a given year.

It copies the shape of the real project: a directed score per pair and year, counts per pair and year, a codebook, a figure and a working paper.

- [Data](data.qmd): download the files
- [Codebook](codebook.qmd): what each column means
- [Figures](figures.qmd)
